tip: 常见的基础兵种之一，手持短兵，各方数据比较均衡。发动暴击时造成持续1.5秒的混乱状态。
A common basic Troop Type wielding blades, with balanced stats across the board. Critical hits inflict Confusion for 1.5 seconds.
应召而来的义军组成的部队，拥有较快的移动速度，且勇气过人，在发动暴击时可提高自身6点士气。
Troops formed by volunteers answering the call to arms. They boast high movement speed and exceptional courage. Critical hits boost own morale by 6.
持盾的刀兵，虽牺牲了小部分机动性，但防御力获得提升。发动暴击时挑衅目标3秒。
Shield-bearing swordsmen who trade some mobility for improved defense. Critical hits Taunt the target for 3 seconds.
凶悍的蛮族士兵，拥有较高的攻击，破坏与机动型，但远程防御较为薄弱。发动暴击时造成持续2秒的混乱状态。
Ferocious barbarian soldiers with high attack, destruction, and mobility, but weak ranged defense. Critical hits inflict Confusion for 2 seconds.
藤甲重量较轻，且有很强的防御力，但非常怕火，在遭受火系军魂技能的打击或在火焰中时，受到的伤害会翻倍。发动暴击时挑衅目标5秒，并使自身在8秒内提升20%的防御。

Rattan armor is lightweight yet highly defensive, but extremely vulnerable to fire—damage from Fire Command Spirit skills or flames is doubled. Critical hits Taunt the target for 5 seconds and boost own defense by 20% for 8 seconds.
蜀汉精锐重装部队，虽欠缺机动性，但有着极强的防御能力。由于部队的标志性装束是白色的鸟羽或兽毛，故称之为白毦兵。发动暴击时挑衅对方5秒，并使自身在5秒内反弹20%的伤害。

An elite heavy unit of Shu Han, lacking mobility but boasting exceptional defense. Named the White Feather Guard for their iconic plumes of white feathers or animal hair. Critical hits taunt the target for 5 seconds and reflect 20% of damage taken for 5 seconds.
特指冲锋在前、勇夺敌军锐气的先头部队，战斗经验丰富、杀敌无数，常常拥有比其他部队更高的士气。发动暴击时使自身在8秒内提升30%的攻击，并在10秒内提升50%的移动速度。

Refers specifically to vanguard troops who charge at the forefront to shatter the enemy's momentum. Battle-hardened with countless kills, they often possess higher morale than other units. Critical hits boost own Attack by 30% for 8 seconds and Move Speed by 50% for 10 seconds.
最早由曹操建立的短兵部队，具有惊人的作战能力。因部队在作战时犹如猛虎下山，故称之为“虎卫”。发动暴击时50米范围内所有我方部队提高3点士气。

Originally established by Cao Cao as a Blade unit with astonishing combat prowess. Because they fought like tigers descending the mountain, they were called the ‘Tiger Guard’. Critical hits boost morale of all allied units within 50m by 3.
常见的基础兵种之一，手持长枪，对骑兵有一定的克制力。发动暴击时使目标3秒内无法移动。
A common basic troop type wielding long spears, effective against cavalry. Critical hits immobilize the target for 3 seconds.
持盾的枪兵，虽牺牲了小部分机动性，但防御力获得提升。发动暴击时使目标4秒内无法移动。
Shield-bearing spearmen who trade some mobility for improved defense. Critical hits Immobilize the target for 4 seconds.
专门配有重型铁铠的枪兵，机动性略有下降，但更方面的防御能力均有提升。发动暴击时使目标4秒内无法移动。
Spearmen outfitted with heavy iron armor. Slightly less mobile, but with improved defense across the board. Critical hits Immobilize the target for 4 seconds.
由孙权创办的卫戍部队，近战输出能力不俗，但机动性与防御能力略显一般，是东吴的精锐部队。发动暴击时使目标4秒内无法移动，且使自身在10秒内降低50%被包围时的士气损失

A garrison unit founded by Sun Quan with solid melee output but average mobility and defense. An elite Eastern Wu force. Critical hits immobilize the target for 4 seconds and reduce own morale loss from encirclement by 50% for 10 seconds
冀州出现的特殊部队，因统一兵器为长戟而得此名，有很强的推进能力。发动暴击时使目标8秒内无法移动。
A special unit from Ji Province, named for their standardized halberds. They excel at pushing forward. Critical hits immobilize the target for 8 seconds.
特指出身于丹阳郡的善战之人，丹阳兵的机动与输出能力都很可观，袁术曾经以“此地精兵辈出而闻名”来评价丹阳。发动暴击时使目标8秒内无法移动，并瞬间恢复自身10%的伤兵。

Refers specifically to skilled warriors hailing from Danyang Commandery. Danyang troops boast impressive mobility and damage output, Yuan Shu once praised Danyang as ‘famed for producing elite soldiers.’ Critical hits immobilize the target for 8 seconds and instantly recover 10% of wounded troops.
原为盘踞青州的黄巾余党，在青州主力向曹操无条件投降后，被后者重新编排为青州兵。在曹魏的管理下，青州部队已脱胎换骨，不在像过去的流民形式作战，早已成为北方的中坚力量之一。发动暴击时使目标4秒内无法移动，并提高自身6点士气。

Originally Yellow Turban remnants entrenched in Qing Province, after their main force surrendered unconditionally to Cao Cao, they were reorganized into the Qing Province Soldiers. Under Cao Wei, they were completely transformed, no longer fighting as roving refugees but becoming one of the mainstays of the north. Critical hits immobilize the target for 4 seconds and boost own morale by 6.
历史悠久的精锐部队，特指军中骁勇善战的勇士，抵抗力远高于一般部队，是在汉室被掌控之前，仅听命于天子一人的特殊直属部队。发动暴击时50米范围内所有敌方部队下降3点士气。

A storied elite force of the fiercest warriors, with resilience far surpassing ordinary troops. Before the Han court fell under warlord control, they answered to the Emperor alone. Crits reduce the Morale of all enemy units within 50m by 3.
原为吕布麾下大将高顺所统领的精锐部队，骁勇善战、装备精良，具有很强的突击能力，每所攻击无不破者，名为“陷阵营”。发动暴击时使目标阵型变为无阵。

Originally an elite unit commanded by Lu Bu's general Gao Shun—valiant in battle, well-equipped, and possessing formidable charge capability, wherever they attacked, none could withstand them, earning them the name ‘Formation Breakers’. Critical hits change the target's formation to No Formation.
常见的基础兵种之一，高机动性部队的代表，若妥善利用，常常可发挥出意想不到的效果。发动暴击时降低目标5点士气。
A common basic troop type and the quintessential high-mobility force. Used properly, they can often achieve unexpected results. Critical hits reduce target morale by 5.
重甲骑兵，因配备了更加厚重坚实的铁铠而稍稍降低了机动性，但使得骑兵的威胁性获得了极大的提升。发动暴击时降低目标8点士气。
Heavily armored cavalry. Their thick iron armor slightly reduces mobility but dramatically increases their threat level. Critical hits reduce target morale by 8.
原为董卓部下李傕所统领的轻装精锐骑兵，具有极强的攻击力和破坏力。发动暴击时使目标8秒降低15%的防御，并降低目标8点士气。
Originally light elite cavalry under Dong Zhuo's general Li Jue, with devastating Attack and Siege Damage. Critical hits reduce the target's defense by 15% for 8 seconds and lower target morale by 8.
特指由凉州一带的精锐重装骑兵，比普通的重骑兵具有更强的攻防能力，曾由西凉军阀马腾所统领。发动暴击时造成持续4秒的混乱状态，并降低目标8点士气。

Elite heavy cavalry from the Liang Province region, surpassing ordinary heavy cavalry in both offense and defense. Once commanded by the Xiliang warlord Ma Teng. Crits inflict Confusion for 4 seconds and reduce target Morale by 8.
又称解烦卫，由孙权为对抗大举东征的刘备而创建的直属精锐部队。解烦，意在【战无不胜，能解困危】，曾由东吴大将韩当统领。发动暴击时50米范围内所有我方部队的伤兵恢复5%。

Also known as the Resolute Guard, an elite unit formed under Sun Quan's direct command to counter Liu Bei's massive eastern campaign. The name means 【invincible, able to overcome any peril】. Once led by Eastern Wu general Han Dang. Critical hits restore 5% of wounded for all allied units within 50m.
由曹操亲自建立的最强先锋部队，据传虎豹骑的成员皆为天下骁锐与百人将，曾是曹魏的核心精锐部队。发动暴击时降低目标15点士气，并提高自身5点士气。

The strongest vanguard force personally established by Cao Cao. Its members were said to be the realm's fiercest warriors and centurions, forming the core elite of Cao Wei. Crits reduce target Morale by 15 and boost own Morale by 5.
常见的基础兵种之一，由于远程进攻手段有限，弓兵为陆战最重要的组成部分之一，虽防御薄弱，但运用得当仍可发挥关键作用。
A common basic troop type. With limited ranged options, archers are one of the most vital components of land warfare. Though weak in defense, they play a crucial role when used properly.
身披盔甲的进阶弓兵，攻防端都有一定提升。
An armored advanced archer with improved offense and defense.
装备弩的射手，与弓兵相比具有更强的攻击力，但射程有所降低。
Crossbow-armed shooters with higher attack than archers but reduced range.
身披盔甲的进阶弩兵，使用强有力的劲弩，攻击和射程都有所提高。发动暴击时降低目标8点士气。
An armored advanced crossbowman wielding a powerful heavy crossbow with improved attack and range. Critical hits reduce target morale by 8.
装备了元戎连弩的弩兵部队，在中距离时，部队的攻击力与压制力达到了极致。发动暴击时使目标在8秒内降低50%的移动速度。
Crossbow troops equipped with the Yuanrong repeating crossbow. At mid-range, the unit's Attack and suppression reach their peak. Critical hits reduce target Move Speed by 50% for 8 seconds.
由射手中的精锐选拔而出的司隶部队，精湛的射术使该部队具有比弓兵更远的射程，在汉室被掌控之前，仅听命于天子一人的特殊直属部队。发动暴击时50米范围内所有己方部队在8秒内提高15%攻击力。

A Sili unit recruited from the finest archers, with range surpassing that of regular Archers. Before the Han court fell under warlord control, they answered to the Emperor alone. Critical hits boost the Attack of all allied units within 50m by 15% for 8 seconds.
由诸葛亮征服南蛮后，利用蛮夷人力组建的一支善战部队，不但精于射术，在近战时同样拥有堪比精锐步兵的战斗力。发动暴击时造成持续8秒的中毒状态（每秒减少5%伤兵），并在10秒内提升50%的移动速度

A formidable unit assembled from Nanman manpower after Zhuge Liang conquered the Nanman. Not only skilled archers, they also match elite infantry in melee combat. Critical hits inflict the Poisoned status for 8 seconds (reducing wounded by 5% per second) and boost Move Speed by 50% for 10 seconds
骑在马背上的远程部队，作战极为灵活。
Mounted ranged troops, extremely flexible in combat.
最早由公孙瓒为对抗胡人而组建的精锐骁骑，因队中多为白马，故被传为白马义从。发动暴击时增加半格军团战蓄力槽并导致目标混乱4秒。

Elite swift cavalry originally formed by Gongsun Zan to combat the Hu tribes, as most rode white horses, they were known as the ‘White Horse Volunteers’. Critical hits fill half a bar of the Legion Battle charge gauge and inflict Confusion on the target for 4 seconds.
